_note: Route-existence sweep: uniform (Erdos-Renyi) networks, REALISTIC capacity (lognormal mu=3 sigma=1, median limit ~20 units, randomised starting balances). Same grid and amount (10) as uniform-unlimited, so the curves are directly comparable and the only difference is capacity. Randomised balances make a direction's spare capacity uniform over its swing, so a payment of 10 is often blocked even though the topology has a path. See ../README.md and packages/tallysim/docs/design.md.
